Aristocrat Leisure Limited (ASX: ALL) is a leading gaming content creation company powered by technology to deliver industry-leading casino games together with mobile games and online real money games, collectively entertaining millions of players worldwide, every day. description:

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

Role: Data Integration Manager

The Data Integration Manager is the go-to expert for active client integrations within Power Digital’s nova ecosystem. This role owns the design, delivery, and maintenance of custom data pipelines. You will lead scoping calls, gather requirements, and map how a client’s modern data stack connects into our systems. You’ll manage project timelines, set expectations, and act as the primary point of contact from integration design through QA and delivery. You’ll also maintain integrations built through tools like Funnel and Fivetran, and troubleshoot errors.

You’ll partner with Account teams to understand client business goals and with our Data Intelligence team to ensure integrations are structured to power advanced marketing science, and reporting. This role requires ongoing collaboration across technical and client-facing teams to ensure data pipelines are not only operational, but also actionable for marketing science and strategy.

The ideal candidate blends strong technical expertise with polished client-facing skills and a project-owner mindset. You are equally comfortable managing a client relationship, digging into a pipeline error, validating a dataset, or explaining integration progress to stakeholders. Above all, you ensure integrations run smoothly, data is trustworthy, and teams across Power Digital can rely on the foundation you’ve built.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for active client data integrations within the nova ecosystem.
  • Lead scoping calls with clients to gather requirements and map their modern data stack into Power Digital’s systems.
  • Own project timelines and deliverables for custom integrations, ensuring clear communication with both clients and internal teams.
  • Partner with Account teams to align integrations with client business goals and reporting needs.
  • Collaborate with the Data Intelligence team to structure integrations that power advanced analytics, modeling, and marketing science.
  • Build, monitor, and maintain custom data integrations using data share solutions like: SFTP transfer, Snowflake Data Share, and other custom integration methods.
  • Build, monitor, and maintain integrations using tools like Funnel and Fivetran.
  • Troubleshoot connector issues and coordinate timely resolution to minimize downtime.
  • Perform data cleaning, QA, validation, and readbacks to ensure accuracy and reliability of integrated datasets.
  • Support data modeling projects using SQL and dbt.
  • Maintain documentation and best practices for custom integrations.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve integration processes, efficiency, and scalability.

Role Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of experience in data integration, analytics engineering, or a related role.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or other data programming languages.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data and integration challenges.
  • Experience in data modeling and ETL workflows.
  • Experience working with modern data stack tools such as Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Funnel, and Fivetran (or comparable platforms).
  • Familiarity with BI and reporting tools such as Looker (Enterprise and Studio) and/or other visualization platforms.
  • Proven client-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally across technical, analytics, and account management teams.
  • Familiarity with Python or another data-focused programming language (a plus).
  • Prior agency experience or experience managing multiple client stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Understanding of marketing and financial KPIs
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Onboarding Speed & Completion : >90% of new clients with all required data integrated into nova within the first 30 days of onboarding.
  • Connector Uptime & Reliability : >90% uptime of Fivetran/Funnel connections (target ≥ 98%) and average time-to-resolution for connector errors.
  • Data Quality & Accuracy : ≥95% of custom integrations that pass QA/readbacks without critical issues.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Timely and complete client onboarding integrations
  • Reliable and error-free data pipelines
  • High-quality, validated datasets powering DI and Account teams
  • Clear communication and accountability across client and internal stakeholders

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. – shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Operations Regulatory Engineer you ensure that Offshore Asset operations within your assigned scope continuously comply with applicable international and local regulations (also as assigned), with all related permits, licenses, certificates, and other authorizations, maintained valid at all times.

Responsibilities

  • You maintain an effective interface with all Regulatory Body and Recognized Organization representatives (e.g., Surveyors, Auditors) relevant to your assigned scope.
  • You remain informed of applicable regulations and related requirements and communicate them as required.
  • You provide support to the related Operations Management team(s) in understanding regulatory requirements applicable to their scope and in taking appropriate actions to sustainably meet those.
  • Jointly with the Operations Management teams, you plan and manage activities required to maintain regulatory permits, licenses, certificates (including notably Class) and other authorizations, valid at all times.
  • You maintain regulatory registers and records up-to-date.
  • You monitor the continued compliance with and validity of certificates and other authorizations.
  • You attend regulatory surveys and audits relevant to your assigned scope.
  • You lead or contribute to investigations of regulatory incidents if/as assigned.
  • You ensure completion of corrective actions related to your assigned scope.
  • You provide accurate reports for internal and external communication.
  • You communicate effectively and collaborate with all Stakeholders to ensure effective results.
  • You escalate critical issues to Management if required.

Education

  • Engineering or university degree in a relevant field e.g. Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Environmental Science, Law, Quality.
  • Professional certification in regulatory compliance or QHSE management (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH).
  • Qualified Auditor/Surveyor.

Experience

  • Experience in a relevant industry sector, e.g. Maritime, Certification, Oil & Gas (ideally including FPSO operations), Petrochemicals.

Functional Competencies

  • Monitoring performance and compliance
  • Regulatory, law trends and developments
  • Regulatory Management
  • Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring
  • SBM Product Knowledge
  • Internal Audit
  • Delivery
  • Management systems standards and framework
  • Environmental Management
  • Hazard Identification and Risk Management

General Information

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Sales Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Sales Consultants will travel to customer's homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations, develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Sales Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Sales Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Sales Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs.

title: Senior Cloud Serverless Developer
description:
At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

The opportunity

Cloud Developer needed to join our team on a contract basis, here at VML Enterprise Solutions.

The opportunity: We are looking for talented Cloud Developers with experience developing complex Cloud AWS serverless applications to join an exciting client project as part of our experienced team of Cloud developers, platform engineers and data engineers.

Please note we offer remote contracts for individuals based in the EU or Brazil .

Please note the selection process will be conducted in English.

What you’ll be doing

This is a great opportunity to get involved in a large-scale Generative AI project and will require you to be comfortable working with serverless technologies in small autonomous squads working as part of a larger programme.

We keep our knowledge fresh by continually looking for new technologies and sharing what we’ve learned. As part of our team, you will actively enjoy learning new technologies and developing your skills and will contribute to this process.

What we want from you

  • Experience developing complex cloud-native serverless applications
  • Experience with AWS Serverless products, including AWS S3 and DynamoDB
  • Experience building solutions with considerations around data & security
  • Understanding of DevOps principles
  • Understanding an Infrastructure-as-Code language (e.g. CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience Automation Testing
  • Strong Communication, with excellent written and spoken skills
  • Experience working in a fast-paced agile team

If you know some of this, even better

  • Experience Serverless architectures and AWS Lambda (Written in TypeScript)
  • Experience with DynamoDB Single Table Design
  • Experience with SSO and OIDC
  • Experience with architecting systems which isolate data between users
  • Experience with Microservices and API Gateway
  • Test-Driven development, with a quality-driven mindset: Testing frameworks Jest and PlayWright
  • Consideration of cross cutting concerns (e.g. Observability, Security)
  • Understanding of modern authentication protocols (OAuth2, OIDC)
  • Interest and experience with generative AI LLMs and Image Diffusion models

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

About VML Enterprise Solutions

Our Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi-channel growth for world-leading brands.

We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes-Benz, Johnson & Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany & Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.

As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.

Job description

O que é a nstech?

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. The Managing Principal Engineer:

  • Leads in their area of specialization and assigns work according to priority.
  • Acts as a technical resource and mentor to principal, senior and entry to mid-level engineers in area of responsibility.
  • Is responsible for day-to-day activities, including the maintenance of the quality, content, consistency and continuity of all technical work performed in an assigned technical unit or area.

What You Will Do

  • Responsible for the technical verification of tasks related to ship/statutory disciplines and training new engineers in these areas.
  • Assists in the development of short- and long-range business plans and related annual operating and capital expense budgets.
  • Maintains active awareness of business and management developments affecting present and potential customers.
  • Maintains awareness of product and service capabilities of the business. Identifies improvement and developmental needs, takes action to capitalize on prospective market opportunities and makes recommendations for technology or technical tools and manpower skills necessary to implement new and improved products and services.
  • Ensures that assigned engineering positions are adequately staffed with qualified and competent engineering personnel capable of carrying out assigned technical projects in accordance with established policies, procedures and technical standards.
  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements are fulfilled with regard to project work within a technical unit or area.
  • Monitors the delivery and quality of technical services to customer satisfaction.
  • Prepares annual performance appraisals. Evaluates and communicates individual performance appraisal issues with staff members under his/her direct supervision, and recommends compensation adjustments and advancements to senior management.
  • Identifies training needs and determines appropriate training programs for developing the potential of subordinate and engineering staff members.
  • Plans and monitors ABS mandatory, required and other training needs of subordinate staff members.
  • May serve as account manager on technical projects for designated customers and actively promotes the services of ABS to clients.
  • May serve on technical or industry committees and may represent the company as spokesperson at industry conferences or meetings.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • B.S. degree Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineer; an M.S. is preferred
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services, and their anticipated future work. The knowledge and ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, concerning technical issues to laymen and experts.
  • Technical background on designing and /or reviewing different types of ships.

For those with Hull backgrounds

  • B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • Exposed to the Finite Element Method (coursework or supervised research).

For those with Machinery backgrounds

  • B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Graduate from University and a minimum of 15 years of related industry experience.
  • B.S. degree Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineer; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Experience in the design and review of ship structures for offshore support vessels, tugs, pushers, and barges for rivers, intracoastal, and oceangoing services; Familiarity with large merchant vessels is also considered an asset.
  • Proficiency in conducting intact and damage stability analyses for ships and offshore structures. This includes freeboard calculations and conditions of assignment, verification of loading manuals, operating manuals, and other related documentation.

Knowledge of safety arrangements requirements for ships and offshore structures, based on applicable International Conventions and Regulations for an extensive range of ships and floating units, including Brazilian-flagged vessels, including but not limited to Stability, Load Line, Tonnage, SOLAS, MARPOL, IBWMC, MLC, NORMAMs etc

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports directly to a Senior Managing Principal Engineer or higher. Direct reports to the incumbent are members of the engineering or technical staff and office support staff of the assigned technical unit or area.

title: Project Manager
description:
A leading real estate development firm specializing in delivering high-quality residential and commercial properties. With a reputation for innovation and attention to detail, they manage multiple projects from inception to completion, ensuring that every aspect of development meets the highest standards. The team is now looking for a detail-oriented and adaptable Project Manager to support their operations and manage project-related tasks effectively.

Location:
Fully-Remote (Work from Home), 9 AM - 5 PM CST

Role Overview:
As a Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that all project documentation and workflows are managed accurately and efficiently. You will assist in material take-offs, submittals, project scheduling, and collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure that real estate development projects are completed on time and within budget. This role requires proficiency in project management software and the ability to learn new tools and processes on the job.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Documentation & Organization:

    • Use software like Bluebeam (or similar) to perform material take-offs and ensure accuracy for construction and real estate development projects.

    • Review submittals and shop drawings, preparing them for distribution to contractors and stakeholders.

    • Organize and maintain project folders, ensuring all documents are properly filed and easily accessible for the development team.

    • Create and modify Gantt chart schedules to track project timelines and milestones.

  • Subcontractor Management & Agreements:

    • Take sub proposals and convert them into formal subcontracts, ensuring all terms and conditions are clearly defined for each construction phase.

    • Use templates to create subcontractor agreements and Exhibits for the scope of work once projects are awarded.

    • Handle partial and final lien waivers for work performed and as payments are drawn from clients.

  • Quoting & Pricing:

    • Learn the company’s quoting software for windows, cabinets, and doors, and create accurate quotes for materials and services required in real estate development.

    • Provide detailed material take-offs and pricing using the window, cabinet, and door quoting software.

  • Scheduling & Weekly Updates:

    • Update and maintain weekly scheduling using Smart Sheet and prepare regular updates for project superintendents.

    • Prepare weekly update sheets and photos for the superintendents to send to clients, keeping them informed on the progress of each project.

  • Training & Adaptability:

    • Train and learn to use new software systems as needed for window take-offs and pricing, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all tasks.

    • Be adaptable and trainable to learn and integrate new tools and processes as the company grows and evolves in the real estate development field.

  • Client & Contractor Communication:

    • Work closely with project managers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and project execution.

    • Handle the distribution of AIA form contracts to clients/customers and ensure proper documentation for compliance.

Qualifications

  • Experience:

    • 2+ years experience in project management, or a similar role.

    • Strong command of English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    • Experience using Bluebeam or similar software for material take-offs and project documentation in the real estate and construction sectors.

    • Knowledge of reviewing submittals and shop drawings and the ability to prepare them for distribution.

    • Experience creating and modifying Gantt chart schedules for tracking real estate development timelines.

    • Familiarity with creating subcontracts and using templates for subcontractor agreements and scope of work documents.

    • Experience with Smart Sheet scheduling and the ability to update schedules weekly.

    • Familiarity with managing lien waivers (partial and final) and AIA form contracts in the real estate development context.

    • Must be adaptable and willing to train on new software tools relevant to real estate and construction processes.

    • Previous experience in the real estate development or construction industry is preferred but not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and timely execution of material take-offs and documentation for construction and real estate development projects.

  • Effective management of subcontractor agreements and ensuring all terms are met and paperwork is in order.

  • Successful management of project schedules and timely updates provided to stakeholders.

  • Smooth integration of new software tools, with minimal learning curve and quick adaptation to company processes.

  • Clear communication and proactive problem-solving to support the team and ensure projects stay on track.

Opportunity
This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing real estate development firm. As a Project Manager, you will gain valuable experience working on high-profile projects while also having the chance to develop your skills in project management, client communication, and software usage. If you are motivated, adaptable, and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply and contribute to the company’s continued success.

  • Fill in the application form

  • Record a video showcasing your skill sets

About The Role

The Product Manager for Elfie Research will design and deliver study-specific product experiences that align with clinical protocols while keeping participants engaged. You’ll bridge clinical science and user behavior—customizing Elfie’s features to support data collection, adherence, and study success. By combining research rigor with user-centered design, you’ll ensure each study is both operationally sound and impactful.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract - With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare - From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup - Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework - Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • PTO + Public Holidays - Real time off
  • Hybrid Working - 3 days in the office per week

What You’ll Do

Own the end-to-end product execution for clinical studies run through Elfie, ensuring each study is flawlessly designed, launched, and tracked to meet scientific and operational objectives

Bridge the clinical and consumer worlds by translating study protocols into engaging, user-friendly product experiences that align with patient needs and behavior

Customize Elfie’s features —including health programs, wellness journeys, and engagement mechanisms—to meet the specific requirements of each research protocol

Collaborate closely with clinical researchers, scientific advisors, and external study partners to ensure product compliance with study standards and ethical guidelines

Work directly with the internal Elfie Research business unit to support broader goals such as generating publishable outcomes and advancing Elfie’s scientific credibility

Define study-specific product flows and data tracking logic , aligning with clinical endpoints, compliance needs, and user retention goals

Ensure on-time delivery across cross-functional teams including product, content, engineering, data, and operations to meet study launch and reporting milestones

Continuously improve the research product experience , leveraging user insights and operational feedback to strengthen adherence, data quality, and study success

What You’ll Need

Product & project management

5+ years of experience in product or program management, ideally in digital health, clinical research, or healthcare technology

Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects from scoping to execution, under strict timelines

Demonstrated experience delivering user-facing features or workflows with measurable outcomes

Clinical study understanding

Strong familiarity with clinical study protocols, trial phases, and compliance considerations (GCP, informed consent, etc.)

Experience working with or supporting clinical operations, digital health research, or patient-centered trials is a strong plus

User-centered product thinking

Ability to translate scientific requirements into intuitive, engaging user journeys and behavior-supportive product flows

Skilled in customizing existing product systems (e.g., programs, engagement tools) to align with research-specific needs

Cross-functional & stakeholder collaboration

Excellent communication skills in English, with experience working directly with clinical researchers, external partners, and internal stakeholders

Comfortable aligning product, data, content, and engineering teams toward common study objectives

Technical & analytical fluency

Comfortable working with data teams to define tracking frameworks for clinical endpoints and user activity

Proficiency in tools like Figma, Notion, and product analytics platforms is a plus

Preferred Background

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product, Public Health, Life Sciences, Engineering, or similar); advanced degree is a plus

Experience in early-stage startups or health-tech environments is preferred

Why Join Elfie?

We're a global start-up that ismission-led, and fiercely product-driven.

We're building something that improves lives - and we're doing it with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

About Elfie

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal? To become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform — across all therapeutic areas.

We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025.

title: Customer Support Agent - French
description:
Overview

Behind the scenes of every successful company, there's a team of dedicated individuals committed to ensuring customers receive the support they need. Customer support representatives are essential, handling inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and offering solutions while maintaining a positive approach. A day in the life of a customer support representative involves delivering positive experiences, fostering trust, and leaving a lasting impression. We are a diverse team with individual skills and strengths; when we work as a unit, everyone learns from each other and becomes better equipped to handle new challenges. We offer opportunities for professional development within the company.

As a Customer Support Agent, you are responsible for the effective processing and logistics flow of our total order flow process in the French region and customer satisfaction within the EMEA Fluke Order Management Team. You will handle a variety of tasks while applying communication and problem-solving skills to assist customers with queries, building strong relationships and ensuring loyalty and satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Process orders and complaints by researching and resolving problems or complaints regarding inaccurate and/or improper deliveries, damages, and claims.
  • Supply all required information and documents regarding delivery, customs regulation and formalities, transportation/shipping, and invoicing.
  • Inform channel partners about prices, delivery times, the content of the order, and any other commercial information by phone, email, and online.
  • Process quotes based on sales or channel partner input.
  • Responsible for continuous improvement of customer satisfaction.
  • Be part of the multinational Order Management EMEA team which is integral to business success.
  • Recognize the variety of cultures and languages within the team, contributing to a fun, engaging, and supportive environment where input is valued.

Experience

  • Intermediate vocational degree/MBO.
  • Previous experience in logistics or electronic equipment and planning environment is preferred.
  • Proficiency in English and French.
  • Excellent digital literacy, including MS Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Can-do mentality and strong customer focus.
  • A keen eye for detail.

Why you should join Fluke

  • We value humility and are as interested in you as a person as we are in your talent. We believe that diversity drives innovation and contributes valuable insights.
  • Transparency, openness, and a willingness to learn are part of our core values. We offer an international and friendly work environment with energetic company culture.
  • Aligning business and personal needs is important, so we provide flexibility to enable you to bring your best to work.
  • We support important causes and team up to find meaningful ways to give back to the community through the Fluke Day of Caring.
  • Working at Fluke gives you access to a robust career development process and exciting opportunities focused on growth.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Fluke

Fluke is leading the world in creating software, test tools and technology that will support customers today and in the future. We are a customer-obsessed market leader with a strong reputation for reliability, quality and safety. A wholly owned subsidiary of Fortive Corporation, Fluke is a global corporation headquartered in the greater Seattle area. Driven by the successful Fortive Business System, Fluke offers the passion of a startup with the resources of a Fortune 500 company. We focus on the growth of our individual employees, teams and the Fluke brand.

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Conhece de metodologias de gestão de projetos Agile e Waterfall;
  • Comunicação direta: você é uma pessoa comunicadora ativa e ouvinte atenta. Você sabe receber bem feedbacks sinceros e vê cada um deles como uma oportunidade de crescer;
  • Lidar bem com mudanças constantes. O isaac está em constante evolução, então nossas prioridades também. O que você trabalhou no mês passado pode não ser o que você trabalha hoje e isso te anima;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e se comunicar de maneira assertiva e influente com stakeholders;
  • Senso de urgência e responsabilidade e é uma pessoa organizada e proativa.
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash flexível - R$40,50/dia);

  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vempraisaac

Analista de Experiência Conversacional Pleno

Somos a Stone, empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente. Nosso propósito é transformar a indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e convertendo sonhos em resultados. Guiados pelos 5 pilares da nossa cultura: Own It, Live the Ride, No Bullshit, Team Play e The Reason. Buscamos gerar impacto para o cliente por meio de interações de qualidade e entrega de valor.

Somos o time responsável pelo desenvolvimento e evolução de chatbots copilotos, uma ferramenta que utiliza Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Nossa missão é criar interações fluidas, eficientes e inteligentes que não apenas resolvam problemas, mas também encantem nossos usuários.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Experiência Conversacional Pleno

Você será a voz do nosso cliente dentro do produto, atuando como o arquiteto das conversas do nosso copiloto. Sua missão é prover interações empáticas e eficazes entre o usuário e o chatbot, transformando interações complexas em jornadas simples e intuitivas. Você investigará o que funciona, identificará dificuldades dos clientes e proporá melhorias que impactem positivamente a satisfação e a eficiência do nosso principal canal de contato.

Principais Responsabilidades :

  • Desenhar e escrever interações objetivas, garantindo que o tom de voz do copiloto seja consistente, empático e alinhado à marca.
  • Analisar dashboards e dados para extrair insights acionáveis e responder: onde estamos falhando, o que otimizar, qual o impacto das mudanças.
  • Identificar necessidades e dores dos usuários através da análise de conversas, feedbacks e dados de uso, traduzindo achados em melhorias práticas.
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Engenharia e Dados para construir e validar hipóteses, garantindo visão integrada da experiência.

O que esperamos de você

  • Familiaridade com análise de dados e navegação em dashboards.
  • Capacidade analítica, senso crítico e habilidade de transformar dados em ações de design conversacional.
  • Perfil curioso e proativo, com boa comunicação e colaboração em ambiente multidisciplinar.
  • Mentalidade centrada no cliente e paixão por entender suas dores.
  • Desejável: conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, especialmente em LLMs, e técnicas de Prompt.
  • Desejável: experiência com produtos conversacionais (chatbots, voicebots) e/ou jornada do cliente.

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Looker, Power BI).
  • Noções de SQL ou Python para análise de dados.

Jornada de Trabalho

  • Escala: Segunda à sexta-feira.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; Hospital Digital com equipe médica disponível 24/7; Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação (Sodexo); Auxílio Creche; Vale Transporte (para vagas presenciais); Salário Fixo + PLR (quando preenchidos os requisitos); Benefício Educação (plataforma interna com recursos de desenvolvimento).

Inscrição, entrevistas com o time de People, entrevista com liderança + case, check de cultura e feedback final. Inscreva-se e venha conhecer a nossa cultura e o desafio.

description:
Overview

Sylvera provides trusted ratings, tools and data for carbon credits and CDR. Our mission is to incentivize investment in real climate action. Purchasing carbon credits and CDR through the carbon markets is one of the most established and scalable ways to channel finance to effective climate solutions and work toward societal net zero. Sylvera’s data and software independently and accurately validates the impact of carbon projects that capture, remove, or avoid emissions, whether they are up and running or in development. Our tools help users optimise the climate and economic performance of projects and understand past and future market dynamics. With Sylvera, businesses, governments and developers can confidently invest in, benchmark, deliver, and report real climate impact.

Our team is made up of leading minds in climate change from scientists to policy, finance, and carbon market experts. We partner with scientific organizations, universities, governments, and think tanks to develop rigorous project assessment methodologies, leveraging the latest technology. We also collaborate with actors across the market to improve data quality, standardisation and accessibility. Founded in 2020, Sylvera has 130+ employees globally with offices in London, New York, Belgrade and Singapore. We have raised over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners.

What will I be doing?

As a key player in a rapidly evolving space, we are growing our commercial team in Latin America and are hiring an exceptional, self-motivated Sales Development Representative to support and drive pipeline. You’ll work closely with a dedicated Account Executive and the rest of our commercial and marketing team. Fluency in Spanish is a mandatory requirement.

Specific responsibilities

  • Inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting
  • Identify product fit and schedule meetings with accounts
  • Strategize with Account Executives to target prospect accounts to fill pipeline
  • Conduct high-level conversations with all levels up to C-Suite and VP-level Executives to address sustainability goals
  • Create strategic emails and outbound campaigns to target prospect accounts
  • Continuously maintain and update CRM
  • Achieve monthly qualified opportunity metrics and daily KPIs

We’re looking for someone who

  • 2+ years experience in business development, sales or related field with lead qualification at all levels within organisations – managers, directors, VPs, executives
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Full professional proficiency in Spanish
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Previous startup business development experience
  • Cares deeply about the climate and ecosystems of the earth
  • Is a self-starter who thrives in evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience
  • Brings creativity and ideas to help build the business and progress the world to Net Zero goals

What we offer

  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup
  • Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance
  • Unlimited annual leave and encouragement to actually use it
  • 4 weeks/year work from anywhere
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Up to 20 days paid sick leave
  • No corners cut in having the best tech to do your job
  • Access to Mental Health support
  • Monthly team socials

Location

This position will be remote within the country stated in the header.

Our Values

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on momentum, reflect on and learn from our failures.

Stay curious: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and opportunities ahead of us.

Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each other’s success and strengthen the company in the long run.

Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed customer expectations. By serving customers fully, we help direct more investment into real climate impact.

What if you’re a partial fit?

We prioritise grit, positivity, and willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t exactly match this job description.

Equal employment opportunity

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Amazon Basin Reporter (Newsperson)
description:
Overview

The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiasednews in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

We’re seeking a curious and competitive journalist to cover the Amazon rainforest and its influence on the global climate as a reporter based in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo or Brasília), Brazil. This is a temporary grant-funded position lasting through October 2026.

Responsibilities

As part of the Climate and Environment team,this newsperson will cover many topics related to the Amazon, including but not limited to legal and illegal mining forest cutting, logging, fishing and raising of cattle, wildfires, changes in carbon dioxide emissions from deforestation, Indigenous peoples and others who live in the Amazon, government policies and enforcement, nongovernmental organizations and endemic species and habitats. The successful candidate will have the ability and willingness to work any shift, including at night and on weekends, or as coverage demands, as AP is a 24/7 operation.

We\'re looking for someone who will:

  • work among a team of reporters and editors in the U.S. and around the world to deliver spot news and enterprise coverage related to myriad happenings in the Amazon.
  • have a demonstrated history of successful beat reporting, strong source development, storytelling on deadline and the production of explanatory stories that are illuminating and entertaining.
  • have the ability to both tell stories via phone reporting and willingness to travel to various locations in the Amazon.
  • have strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with the diverse team of journalists at the AP who operate in all formats: text, photo, video, audio, digital/social, interactive and graphics.
  • have a great news sense, with the ability to communicate stories that people will want to share, like and talk about on social media and other platforms.
  • pursue innovative storytelling techniques while maintaining AP’s standards for integrity and objectivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, such as at least five years of full-time experience at a daily newspaper, broadcast station, online or digital news outlet, or an AP bureau or regional desk.
  • All applicants must have authorization to work in Brazil or be able to gain permission to do so.
  • Advanced-level professional competency in written and spoken English and Portuguese. Knowledge of both Portuguese and Spanish is a plus.
  • Basic proficiency in using an iPhone for photos and video is required. Advanced proficiency is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple projects across formats and deliver success on complex, challenging story lines.

Preferred Qualifications

We\'re looking for a reporter who can consistently break news and deliver high-impact enterprise stories that appeal to AP’s global audience. This role is for you if you are an idea machine, able to think creatively and critically, and are driven by curiosity. It is essential that you write clearly, concisely and conversationally. You should be able to develop a diverse range of sources who can provide AP with unique stories ahead of competing media outlets. You must be able to work effectively as a member of a team.

We’ll consider strong candidates who do not meet every listed qualification. You may use a cover letter to describe the unique qualifications you would bring to this role.

The application period will expire at 11:59pm on September 26, 2025.

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

Behind the scenes of every successful company, there's a team of dedicated individuals committed to ensuring customers receive the support they need.

A day in the life of a customer support representative is a rollercoaster of emotions, challenges, and victories. It\'s not just about troubleshooting; it\'s about creating positive experiences for every customer, fostering trust, and leaving a lasting impression.

We are all individuals that have their own set of skills and strengths. When the whole team works as a unit, everyone has an opportunity to learn from each other. This process leads to resource building and enables the team to become better equipped to deal with new challenges. While being a strong team working in a good international environment, making us great colleagues amongst each other. There is also an opportunity for professional development within the company in the future.

As a Customer Support Agent, you are responsible for the effective processing and logistics flow of our total order flow process in the French region and customer satisfaction within the EMEA Fluke Order Management Team.

No day in the life of a Customer Support Agent at Fluke is the same. You will be handling a variety of tasks while putting into practice your communication and problem-solving skills to assist customers with queries. By consistently providing a high level of service, you will build strong relationships with customers and ensure loyalty and satisfaction.

In the role of Customer Support Agent, you will:

Personal Skills:

  • Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Can-do mentality and strong customer focus.
  • A keen eye for details.

Why you should join Fluke:

  • We support important causes and team up to find meaningful ways to give back to the community through the Fluke Day of Caring.

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

description:

  2. Modelagem 3D;
  3. Desenhar conjunto de peças e produtos;
  4. Elaboração de desenhos técnicos de fabricação: planificação, detalhamento e montagem de peças;
  5. Buscar a melhoria das características dos componentes, de acordo com normas e especificações técnicas;
  6. Garantir que todas as atividades da DGS estejam sendo realizadas de forma adequada e dentro dos padrões estabelecidos;

Idiomas: Inglês - Nível Intermediário

Outros requisitos:

  1. Formação: Design de Produto;
  2. Ensino médio técnico em estruturas navais ou áreas correlatas (mecânica etc);
  3. Conhecimento em MS Office;
  4. Conhecimento de Excel;
  5. Oriundo de indústria naval ou náutica;
  6. Experiência em embarcações;

A DGS é uma empresa com 24 anos de existência, que atua há 15 anos na indústria naval na produção de embarcações de uso militar e profissional. Somos um estaleiro situado no Rio de Janeiro, onde desenvolvemos a tecnologia exclusiva ETRH (Embarcações Tubulares Rígidas Híbridas), que configura embarcações mais resistentes, com longo ciclo operacional e baixo custo de manutenção. Na DGS, cada embarcação é um projeto exclusivo, que nasce a partir das necessidades e características especiais das missões de seus clientes. Dentre nossos clientes estão as principais forças de segurança e de defesa do país como a Marinha do Brasil, Exército Brasileiro, Polícia Federal e Corpo de Bombeiros.

A DGS integra a Base Industrial de Defesa (BID) como Empresa Estratégica de Defesa (EED) e nossas embarcações são consideradas Produtos Estratégicos de Defesa (PED). Além disso, possuímos Certificado de Registro do Exército, habilitando-nos para construção e comércio de embarcações dotadas de Produtos Controlados pelo Exército (PCE).

title: ELETRICISTA
description:
O Eletricista é responsável por executar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de sistemas elétricos, garantindo o pleno funcionamento das instalações e a segurança dos ambientes. Este profissional desempenha um papel crucial na manutenção e operação eficiente dos equipamentos e sistemas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, mecânicos e estruturais, garantindo o funcionamento adequado e seguro dos equipamentos e instalações.
  • Diagnosticar e reparar falhas e defeitos em sistemas elétricos, como painéis, fiações, tomadas e interruptores, além de sistemas mecânicos e hidráulicos conforme necessário.
  • Executar a instalação e substituição de componentes elétricos e mecânicos, como motores, circuitos e dispositivos de controle.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares nos sistemas e equipamentos para identificar e corrigir possíveis problemas antes que se tornem críticos.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos, diagramas e manuais técnicos para realizar as manutenções e reparos de acordo com as especificações.
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo as peças substituídas e os problemas encontrados.
  • Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulamentos aplicáveis, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e técnicas seguras.
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe e supervisores para garantir a eficiência e a qualidade na execução das atividades.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter informado sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.
  • Responder a chamadas de emergência e realizar reparos urgentes para minimizar o tempo de inatividade e garantir a continuidade das operações.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo ou técnico na área de elétrica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção elétrica, mecânica e estrutural, com conhecimento em diagnóstico e reparo de falhas.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas elétricos, incluindo leitura de esquemas e diagramas.
  • Certificações e treinamentos específicos na área de manutenção (desejável).
  • Experiência com ferramentas e equipamentos de manutenção.

    • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar o orçamento anual. Monitorar desvios entre orçamento planejado e realizado. Analisar custos operacionais e identificar oportunidades de redução de despesas.
  • Gestão de Pagamentos e Recebimentos

    • Estudar padrões de venda para prever receitas. Realizar análises de precificação e margem de lucro por produto. Identificar produtos ou categorias mais rentáveis para a empresa.

    • Garantir conformidade com obrigações fiscais e tributárias. Analisar impacto tributário em operações financeiras. Trabalhar junto ao setor contábil para minimizar custos tributários.
  • Suporte em Estratégias de Expansão
    • Avaliar viabilidade financeira de novos projetos, como abertura de lojas ou campanhas promocionais. Realizar projeções financeiras para investimentos futuros.

    • Analisar e propor linhas de crédito ou financiamentos para a empresa. Negociar taxas e condições com instituições financeiras. Acompanhar pagamento de financiamentos e dívidas.
  • Compliance e Riscos Financeiros
    • Identificar e mitigar riscos financeiros. Garantir a conformidade com políticas internas e normas regulatórias. Implementar controles financeiros para evitar fraudes e desperdícios.

  • Habilidade analítica e visão estratégica.
  • Domínio de ferramentas financeiras e sistemas de gestão (ERP).
  • Conhecimento em varejo e comportamento de mercado.
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes áreas da empresa.

A ENEL é uma empresa multicultural que valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas. Esta vaga é aberta para talentos de todas as idades, origens étnicas, gêneros, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero e pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Na ENEL acreditamos que a verdadeira inovação surge da diversidade!

Nossa processo de seleção é personalizado para cada função e inclui uma entrevista com nossos recrutadores e uma reunião com o gestor para uma avaliação técnica. Se você estiver alinhado com a descrição do cargo, a equipe de recrutamento entrará em contato com você, fornecendo informações adicionais sobre o processo de recrutamento.

Estamos procurando pessoas que incorporem nossos valores: Confiança, Respeito, Inovação, Proatividade e Flexibilidade.

Você está pronto para fazer a diferença e crescer conosco? Inscreva-se agora e junte-se a nós na liderança da transição energética dentro da equipe de O&M Works South.

Quem somos

Somos líderes globais em geração, distribuição e venda de energia, bem como a maior operadora privada de energia renovável.

Geramos, entregamos e vendemos energia em 28 países na Europa, Américas, África, Ásia e Oceania e somos comprometidos com o desenvolvimento de comunidades locais e clientes.

Estamos empenhados em garantir redes elétricas cada vez mais eficientes, resilientes e digitalizadas, com os mais altos padrões de serviço, a fim de colaborar com o futuro da transição energética.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção de SE III - Itaboraí/RJ
description:
Técnico(a) de Manutenção de SE III - Itaboraí/RJ

A Cotesa tem como propósito ser a melhor parceira do setor elétrico brasileiro. Tem como diretriz de atuação a máxima eficiência, aliada à responsabilidade socioambiental e à segurança de suas equipes, valores compartilhados por seus colaboradores. Queremos em nosso time pessoas comprometidas, que vistam a camisa e estejam sempre dispostas a aperfeiçoar processos e a se engajar em novos desafios. Queremos que nossos colaboradores cresçam junto com a empresa. Se esse é o seu perfil e se você tem tanta paixão pela energia como nós, ficaremos felizes em conhecer você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão da Função:

  • Prestar serviços de manutenção nas instalações, cumprindo os requisitos e processos internos com máxima qualidade e segurança.

Responsabilidade do Técnico de Manutenção II:

  • Executar as manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas em Usina e Subestações, realizando inspeções diárias, semanais, mensais, trimestrais, semestrais, anuais e plurianuais, cumprindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e sugerir as ações necessárias para o cumprimento e mantendo o Sistema de Gestão da Manutenção atualizado a fim de cumprir com o plano de manutenção e garantir a máxima confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos ativos;
  • Acompanhar as atividades de comissionamento e recepção de novos equipamentos de Usina e subestações, a fim de obter a liberação para entrada em operação;
  • Realizar o apontamento de defeitos/anomalias decorrentes das inspeções realizadas nas Instalações, no software de gerenciamento da manutenção, com objetivo de manter atualizado o planejamento de manutenções corretivas;
  • Zelar pelo bom uso e conservação das ferramentas e instrumentos de manutenção de Instalações, com objetivo de manter a segurança e o patrimônio da empresa;
  • Realizar o atendimento às emergenciais, realizar o recebimento de materiais e equipamentos, conferindo com a nota fiscal, controlando, organizando, limpando e mantendo a boa conservação dos sobressalentes, cumprindo os procedimentos estabelecidos, sugerindo melhorias nas condições de armazenamento, objetivando manter o estoque nas melhores condições de utilização, executando inspeções especiais nas Instalações, localizando e identificando as causas de desligamentos automáticos, a fim de reestabelecer os equipamentos no menor prazo possível;
  • Conduzir os veículos da empresa cumprindo a legislação de trânsito e política de frotas, zelando pela segurança, pelo ativo e imagem da COTESA e do Cliente;
  • Cumprir as normativas legais e procedimentos internos, fazendo a correta utilização e conservação dos EPIs e EPC, atuando preventivamente na realização das atividades, identificando situações de risco, propondo ao seu superior imediato medidas de controle, a fim zelar pelas questões de saúde e segurança;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração dos relatórios mensais e técnicos, seguindo os padrões pré-estabelecidos pela engenharia, encaminhando para revisão do supervisor, a fim de cumprir os prazos e requisitos legais do contrato;
  • Fornecer informações técnicas decorrente de falhas e de desempenho de equipamentos e sistemas, relatando informações específicas, a fim de subsidiar a análise dos especialistas da área de Engenharia;
  • Reconhecer os eventos de natureza operativa, em horário de trabalho e quando comunicado pela Operação (tais como desligamentos automáticos, oscilações sistêmicas, alarmes de alta severidade, entre outros...), tomando as providências locais solicitadas pela Operação, afim de garantir máxima disponibilidade dos ativo;
  • Executar a operação local nas instalações telecontroladas, quando houver perda da operação remota, atendendo aos procedimentos de rede, rotinas operacionais e as instruções de operação local, com objetivo de garantir a máxima disponibilidade dos ativos;
  • Contribuir para a conservação das instalações civis, a fim de garantir boas condições de infraestrutura para o adequado desenvolvimento das atividades;
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento entre agentes acessantes/acessada, visando atender os acordos operativos e de compartilhamento das instalações, com o objetivo de manter a máxima cooperação entre as partes;
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento com a equipe local do cliente, a fim de compatibilizar as demandas de serviços decorrentes de solicitações do mesmo e as demandas próprias;
  • Cumprir com as questões ambientais, orientando os demais colegas da equipe, a fim de atender a legislação e programas ambientais vigentes oriundos do licenciamento do empreendimento;
  • Participar da execução dos Planos de Contingência e/ou Planos de Atendimento a Emergências e/ou Planos de Segurança em Barragens, seguindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e implementando as ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, a fim de garantir a operacionalidade e segurança das pessoas e instalações;
  • Prestar atendimento e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme orientação e/ou solicitação do superior imediato.

Responsabilidade do Técnico de Manutenção III: Desenvolverá todas as responsabilidades já descritas para o Técnico de Manutenção II e ainda:

  • Contribuir com o planejamento, coordenação e orientação para execução das atividades do demais colegas da equipe, a fim de garantir a segurança, qualidade do trabalho, o cumprimento dos prazos, metas e indicadores estabelecidos, bem como, identificar possibilidades de melhorias nos processos existentes;
  • Executar os planos de manutenção dos ativos, executado por equipe própria ou terceirizada, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir os procedimentos internos. Identificar os desvios e sugerir ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, mantendo o Sistema de Gestão da Manutenção atualizado com as informações decorrentes da execução do serviço, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade operacional dos ativos;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento dos indicadores da área, identificando fragilidades e distorções, sugerindo ações e auxiliando o supervisor na implementação de ações corretivas, a fim de obter melhores resultados nos processos da área e subsidiar a tomada de decisão em nível estratégico;
  • Recepcionar e acompanhar visitas e auditorias de órgãos externos, conforme orientação do superior imediato, atendendo as demandas e apresentando documentos, a fim de demonstrar que os requisitos legais estão sendo cumpridos conforme as normativas estabelecidas;
  • Auxiliar o supervisor na administração Adm/ Financeira/Contábil local (caixa), cumprindo com os procedimentos administrativos financeiros, contribuindo para a emissão de relatórios de entradas e saídas, com suporte em notas fiscais, a fim de cumprir com os procedimentos administrativo financeiros;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração e execução dos Planos de Contingência e/ou Planos de Atendimento a Emergências e/ou Planos de Segurança em Barragens, seguindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e implementando as ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, a fim de garantir a operacionalidade e segurança das pessoas e instalações;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de especificações técnicas, seguindo procedimento internos, a fim de realizar a contração de serviços especializados;
  • Contribuir com o desenvolvimento dos demais colegas da equipe, orientando a execução das atividades e compartilhando conhecimentos, reportando ao supervisor dificuldades e necessidades de treinamento, a fim de contribuir para a capacitação da equipe.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Técnico em Eletrotécnico, Eletromecânica, Mecânica, Automação, Eletrônica e/ou afins;
  • Carteira de habilitação Cat. B;
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe;
  • Conhecimento do pacote Office;
  • Experiência em Manutenção de Ativos;

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento no Software Gestão da Manutenção EquipMaint.

Informações adicionais:

  • Benefícios: Vale alimentação/Refeição; Seguro de vida; Plano de Saúde; Plano odontológico; Auxílio educação; Parcerias de Desconto (Ipog, Unisul, Clinica Buriti);
  • Local de trabalho: Itaboraí (RJ);

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia.

Descrição da vaga

No Grupo Raion, cultivamos uma cultura dinâmica, criativa e inovadora. Investimos continuamente no treinamento e desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e estamos sempre à procura de novos talentos para se unirem às nossas equipes. Se você aspira expandir sua carreira e maximizar seu potencial em uma empresa que valoriza a excelência, o comprometimento, a dedicação e o sucesso coletivo...

Junte-se a nós e faça parte deste time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar serviços de manutenção e reparos de acordo com a ordem de serviço;
  • Executar o serviço de acordo com a programação/agendamento do chefe de oficina;
  • Retirar o veículo no pátio indicado;
  • Providenciar a colocação das proteções faltantes antes de iniciar os serviços;
  • Apresentar ao chefe de oficina os serviços adicionais;
  • Informar ao Consultor Técnico a entrada em todas as tarefas executadas e baixar após o término da tarefa;
  • Efetuar os demais serviços, e havendo necessidade de serviços adicionais, informar o Consultor Técnico para orçar e contatar o cliente;
  • Preencher corretamente o checklist de manutenção;
  • Solicitar pedido de peças mediante ao conhecimento do Chefe de Oficina;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes da Garantia;
  • Solicitar peças de Garantia somente com autorização do Chefe de Oficina ou Garantista;
  • Limpar as peças usadas substituídas e entregar ao Garantista;
  • Comunicar os responsáveis nos casos de serviço paralisado;
  • Utiliazar todos os equipamentos de proteção quando estiver trabalhando;
  • Realizar ações preventivas e corretivas para garantir o funcionamento do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade e segurança do trabalho;
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações para aprimorar conhecimentos sobre produtos e serviços;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e organização do local de trabalho;

Obedecer às normas e regras institucionais da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo e Curso técnico de mecânica automotiva;
  • Mecânico com experiência mínima 12 meses;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em informática.

Informações adicionais

  • Café da manhã
  • Vale refeição/alimentação FLEX
  • Auxílio alimentação
  • Convênio faculdade
  • Assistência médica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Premiações coletivas por metas
  • Possibilidade de crescimento dentro da empresa

O Grupo Raion é uma empresa atuante no mercado automobilístico, comprometida com o crescimento econômico e o desenvolvimento sustentável, presente nas cidades do Rio de Janeiro, Nova Iguaçu, Caxias, Niterói e Petrópolis.

Com um histórico de 23 anos de operação, o Grupo Raion iniciou suas atividades em 2000, comercializando veículos seminovos de diversas marcas. Com o decorrer dos anos tornou-se representante de marcas fortes no mercado automotivo (Mitsubishi, Suzuki, Nissan, Zeekr e Royal Enfield).

Desde 2007, quando iniciamos as operações com a HPE (fabricante da Mitsubishi e Suzuki), destacamo-nos entre as melhores concessionárias do Brasil, recebendo o Prêmio Diamante & Troféu Super Dealer.

Atualmente composto por 14 concessionárias, realizamos a comercialização de veículos novos, seminovos, venda direta, motocicletas, peças e serviços.

Nossa empresa tem desempenhado um papel ativo no fortalecimento da economia local e na promoção de iniciativas que impulsionam o progresso.

title: Terapeuta Ocupacional - Tijuca, RJ
description:
Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move!

Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico.

Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos.

Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social.

Reforçamos Que Não Solicitamos Pagamentos, Taxas Ou Códigos SMS Em Nossos Processos Seletivos. Todas As Oportunidades Estão Disponíveis Em Nossos Canais Oficiais e No Nosso Site De Carreira. Qualquer Situação Diferente Deve Ser Denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar avaliação nos aspectos sensório-motores e cognitivos a fim de identificar limitações na funcionalidade e desempenho ocupacional nas atividades de auto cuidado, instrumentais da vida diária e de vida prática registrando os dados no formulário "Avaliação de Terapia Ocupacional" que deve ser impressa, assinada e constar nº do registro profissional;
  • Estabelecer objetivos do tratamento terapêutico ocupacional e data de reavaliação a fim de verificar se os objetivos propostos inicialmente foram alcançados e estabelecer a frequência dos atendimentos;
  • Consultar os registros do prontuário, pelo menos das últimas 24 horas antes de iniciar o atendimento do paciente, para compreender melhor o caso e assim ter condições de prestar uma assistência mais adequada;
  • Registrar no prontuário a evolução, após o atendimento do paciente, a fim de documentar a avaliação diária, conduta realizada, resposta do paciente à terapia, alterações de objetivos do tratamento e programação de novas condutas (se necessário), discussões com a equipe multidisciplinar e orientações fornecidas aos pacientes e seus familiares. A qualidade do registro em prontuário irá contribuir para garantir o acesso às informações do paciente e a continuidade do cuidado;
  • Indicar e orientar o uso de equipamento adaptativo e / ou tecnologia assistiva, a fim de facilitar o ganho funcional do paciente, incremento da independência e ganho de qualidade de vida;
  • Orientar e indicar adaptação de órtese bem como mudanças do estilo de vida, com orientação para manejo do tempo e conservação de energia;
  • Verificar a necessidade e escolher apropriadamente os recursos terapêuticos que serão utilizados para o atendimento ao paciente, preferencialmente antes do iniciar o atendimento, com intuito de antecipar as demandas visando prestar uma assistência completa;
  • Monitorar constantemente todos os pacientes em acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional observando a evolução clínica e necessidade de intervenções, a fim de planejar melhor a assistência ao paciente;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares quanto ao tratamento proposto e seus objetivos durante a internação e na alta, com consequente, orientação domiciliar;
  • Preencher a estatística de pacientes atendidos diariamente com objetivo de controle do número atendimentos realizados;
  • Conversar com familiares, pelo menos uma vez ao dia, a fim de explicar os objetivos do acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional e dar oportunidade para esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Seguir normas e rotinas estabelecidas pelo SCIH (Serviço de Controle de Infecções Hospitalar), consultando os documentos disponíveis no sistema GED (Gerenciador de Documentos) e participando dos treinamentos, com o intuito de aplicar as ações e contribuir para a prevenção de infecções hospitalares;
  • Prestar assistência nas unidades de internação quando houver necessidade da Instituição (por exemplo, diminuição do nº de pacientes que precisam da assistência de fisioterapia na UTI);
  • Consultar e-mail corporativo diariamente;
  • Informar a supervisão a respeito de queixas de pacientes/familiares ou problemas gerais;
  • Executar atividades relacionadas aos processos da área, conforme designado pelos líderes imediatos ou de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Conselho de Classe e Anuidade 2025 em dia;
  • Vivência anterior de pelo menos 1 ano em ambiente hospitalar ou ambulatorial, de acordo com o setor de trabalho;
  • Conhecimento intermediário do idioma Inglês;
  • Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, básico ou intermediário;
  • Cursos de aprimoramento ou atualização nas áreas assistenciais;
  • Desejável curso de Suporte Básico de Vida (BLS) ou similar;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de Segunda à Sexta de 8 às 14 na região da Tijuca.

Palavras-Chave: Grupo Amil, Terapia Ocupacional, Terapeuta, Ambulatorial, Hospitalar, PCD, Pessoas com Deficiência, Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro, RJ.
